programs.title: House Hunters
programs.sub_title: Finding the Right Blend in Western PA
programs.desc: A blended family looks for their first home together while also trying to open a bistro in Western Pennsylvania. They want a place where they can have farm animals and she's looking for something grand, but he's just focused on getting a good deal.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A newlywed couple is preparing to blend their families in Orlando, Florida, but he is a first-time homebuyer who is hesitant to go all-in on a purchase, while she has owned homes before and is ready to splurge for their forever home.

programs.title: Masters Of Flip
programs.desc: Kortney and Dave Wilson take on a seemingly small flip, only to transform it into a stunning and sizable family home. While Kortney and her design team get to experiment with a bright color palette, Dave works hard with his crew on a large addition.

programs.title: Small Town Potential
programs.desc: After years of trying, Davina has finally convinced her mom to move to the glorious Hudson Valley to be closer to her and Kristin. Now, the pressure's on Davina and Kristin to find the perfect fit for Mom and deliver a reno with amazing personal touches.

programs.title: Unsellable Houses
programs.desc: The hosts revamp a couple's sprawling 1970s home by giving its massive rooms, which boast wood features, and dated mirrors a modern, luxurious overhaul, transforming it into a home that's sure to allure a number of potential buyers.

programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: The Italian Job in Wildwood, NJ
programs.desc: A trio of weekend warriors pool their resources to buy a beach house that they can renovate for their big Italian family. Their backgrounds in construction and interior design mean they'll tackle the hard work themselves.
